diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-2 Removing accelerator pedal arm
diagrams.description: Illustration showing removal of accelerator pedal arm and bracket securing screws from floor/firewall.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove three screws from accelerator pedal bracket to detach assembly.

diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_3_disconnecting_ball_joints_and_joint_rods.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-3 Disconnecting ball joints and joint rods
diagrams.description: Engine bay perspective showing disconnection of ball joints and joint rods from the torsion shaft and bell-crank.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect ball joints of each rod at torsion shaft support and bell crank bracket to remove joint rods.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_4_accelerator_linkage_setting.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-4 Accelerator linkage setting
diagrams.description: Dimensional and schematic diagram showing accelerator linkage adjustments including rod lengths L and 6, stopper bolt height N, and pedal height.
measurements_and_specs: Stopper bolt height 'N': 22.5 mm (0.886 in) from toe board
Dashboard joint rod length 'L': 117 mm (4.61 in)
Joint rod (6) length: 123 mm (4.84 in)
Pedal height: 194.5 mm (7.66 in)
Stopper bolt contact: contact pedal at throttle 'Fully Open', then turn clockwise one full turn and lock
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Lock stopper bolt securely with lock nut after one full turn clockwise beyond initial contact at full throttle.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_5_fuel_tank_and_fuel_line.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-5 Fuel tank and fuel line
diagrams.description: Perspective layout of the fuel tank, vapor reservoir tank, filler hose, breather hoses, and fuel feed/return lines.
measurements_and_specs: Fuel warning lamp activation level: below 10 liters (10-5/8 U.S. qt., 8-3/4 Imper. qt.)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pay close attention to fuel line due to high operating pressure of the EFI system. Note orientation arrow pointing toward front.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_6_removing_nuts_from_tank_securing_bands.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-6 Removing nuts from tank securing bands
diagrams.description: Underbody view showing removal of the nuts from the two fuel tank securing strap bands.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Lower tank slightly after removing nuts from two securing bands to access top hose connections.

diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_7_removing_rear_quarter_trim.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-7 Removing rear quarter trim
diagrams.description: View of the right-hand rear interior quarter compartment showing removal of quarter trim to expose fuel reservoir and hoses.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Refer to Section BF for detailed interior trim fastener removal.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_8_removing_fuel_filler_hose_protector.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-8 Removing fuel filler hose protector
diagrams.description: Wheel well view showing screws securing the metal protective cover around the fuel filler hose.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen screws attaching fuel filler hose protector and remove it before attempting hose detachment.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_9_cross_sectional_view_of_fuel_hose.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-9 Cross-sectional view of fuel hose
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional cutaway detailing the fuel filler neck, hose, clamp, rubber grommet attachment, and California shutter valve.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Be sure to place stopper of clamp in place when tightening clamp to prevent hose from being pulled out.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_10_fuel_tank_gauge.png
diagrams.rel_link: diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_10_fuel_tank_gauge.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-10 Fuel tank gauge
diagrams.description: Electrical inspection diagram of the fuel sending unit showing terminal pins (1=B, 2=Y, 3=YL), float arm, rheostat, and low-fuel warning thermistor.
measurements_and_specs: Resistance between terminals 1 and 2: 10 to 80 Ω
Thermistor terminal 1-3 resistance changes between submerged and drained state
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use a low-reading ohmmeter. Bayonet twist-lock mounting; replace O-ring whenever removed.

diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_11_heat_shield_plate_to_muffler_clearance.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-11 Heat shield plate-to-muffler clearance
diagrams.description: Dimensional check of clearance between muffler body and outer heat shield plate.
measurements_and_specs: Fore-and-aft clearance: 3 mm (0.12 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Up-and-down and in-and-out alignment can be readily adjusted by means of seats.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_12_installing_muffler_front_mounting.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-12 Installing muffler front mounting
diagrams.description: Dimensioning diagram showing mounting bracket location relative to the front outer face of muffler.
measurements_and_specs: Distance between center of securing bolt and front outer face of muffler: 38 mm (1.50 in)
Distance between front outer face of muffler heat shield plate and rear end face of mounting rubber: 17 mm (0.67 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure 38 mm distance is accurately maintained before tightening mounting.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_13_installing_lower_heat_shield_plate.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-13 Installing lower heat shield plate
diagrams.description: 3D perspective and cross-sectional view showing attachment of lower heat shield plate 1 to muffler front bracket using securing bolt.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install plate 1 on lower face of muffler front bracket and secure with bolt.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_14_installing_upper_heat_shield_plate.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-14 Installing upper heat shield plate
diagrams.description: Procedure diagram showing clamping of upper heat shield plate 2 to lower plate 1 around the exhaust pipe.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten upper and lower plates together by clamp at arrow position.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_15_installing_upper_and_lower_heat_shield_plates.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-15 Installing upper and lower heat shield plates
diagrams.description: Exploded perspective view showing center tube heat shield plates 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and clamps.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Plates 3 and 4 must be adjusted in fore-and-aft direction so they remain strictly parallel with exhaust tube.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_16_mounting_position_of_exhaust_front_tube_heat_shield_plate.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-16 Mounting position of exhaust front tube heat shield plate
diagrams.description: Measurement setup showing the 108 mm (4.25 in) offset from the rear flange face of the front tube to the heat shield plate edge.
measurements_and_specs: Distance between rear face of exhaust front tube and rear end of heat shield plate: 108 mm (4.25 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Adjust position on brackets until exact 108 mm (4.25 in) spacing is achieved before final tightening.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_17_exhaust_front_tube_heat_shield_plate.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-17 Exhaust front tube heat shield plate
diagrams.description: Side assembly view of exhaust front tube showing upper plate 6, lower plate 7, and rear lower plate 8.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Plate 8 is secured at two places together with rear bracket of heat shield plates 6 and 7.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_18_exhaust_front_tube_mounting_bracket.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-18 Exhaust front tube mounting bracket
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional detail of front tube mounting bracket, U-bolt clamp, and attachment of lower heat shield plate 8 at weld nut hole.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Snugly tighten mounting bracket and U-bolt on front tube. Attach plate 8 at weld nut hole.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_19_exploded_view_of_exhaust_system_california_models.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-19 Exploded view of exhaust system (California models)
diagrams.description: Comprehensive exploded view of the complete exhaust system for California models, featuring front tube, catalytic converter, center tube, muffler, all 8 heat shield plates, and rubber mounting details A, B, and C.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: California models incorporate catalytic converter and extensive dual-layer heat shielding. Use new gaskets and bolts at all joints.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_20_exhaust_system_california_models.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-20 Exhaust system (California models)
diagrams.description: Full-vehicle underbody exhaust clearance schematic and section drawings (F-F through L-L) and torque specification details (A through E) for California models.
components: Compression rod rubber heat shield plate
measurements_and_specs: SEC. F-F: 7 mm (0.28 in) min.
SEC. G-G: 15 mm (0.59 in) min.
SEC. H-H: 8 mm (0.31 in) min., 15 mm (0.59 in) min.
SEC. I-I: 18 mm (0.71 in) min., flatness -5 to +5 mm (-0.20 to +0.20 in)
SEC. J-J: 10 mm (0.39 in) min.
SEC. K-K: 10 mm (0.39 in) min., 17 mm (0.67 in) min.
SEC. L-L: 8 mm (0.31 in) min., 10 mm (0.39 in) min.
DETAIL A torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
DETAIL B torques: 1.6 to 2.1 kg-m (12 to 15 ft-lb), 1.8 to 2.1 kg-m (13 to 15 ft-lb), 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
DETAIL B reference distance: 135 mm (5.31 in)
DETAIL C torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
Catalytic converter rear flange torque: 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
DETAIL D torques: 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb), 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
DETAIL D reference distance: 136 mm (5.35 in)
DETAIL E clearance: 3 mm (0.12 in)
DETAIL E torques: 0.93 to 1.2 kg-m (6.7 to 8.7 ft-lb), 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Always replace gaskets and bolts/nuts marked with asterisk '*'. Maintain all specified section clearances to prevent body contact or overheating.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_21_mounting_rubbers.png
diagrams.rel_link: diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_21_mounting_rubbers.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-21 Mounting rubbers
diagrams.description: Inspection and alignment tolerance diagram for exhaust rubber mounting insulators in fore-and-aft, lateral, and rotational twist directions.
measurements_and_specs: Fore-and-aft direction tolerance: 2 to 10 mm (0.08 to 0.39 in)
Lateral direction tolerance: -3 to 3 mm (-0.12 to 0.12 in)
Twist in horizontal direction: Muffler mounting should not be visually twisted.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure mounting insulators are not under undue preload or twisting stress due to misaligned piping.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_22_exploded_view_of_exhaust_system_non_california_models.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-22 Exploded view of exhaust system (Non-California models)
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the Non-California exhaust system showing front tube, pre-muffler, center tube, main muffler, and mounting details A, B, and C.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Non-California models utilize a pre-muffler (resonator) instead of a catalytic converter, and do not use the extensive center tube heat shields.

diagrams.source_md: 1978 280z FSM/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust.md
diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/FE Engine Control fuel and Exhaust/fig_fe_23_exhaust_system_non_california_models.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. FE-23 Exhaust system (Non-California models)
diagrams.description: Underbody layout, cross-sectional clearance checks (F-F through L-L), and tightening torque details (A through E) for Non-California models.
measurements_and_specs: SEC. F-F: 7 mm (0.28 in) min.
SEC. G-G: 15 mm (0.59 in) min.
SEC. H-H: 8 mm (0.31 in) min., 15 mm (0.59 in) min.
SEC. I-I (propeller shaft to pre-muffler): 40 mm (1.57 in) min.
SEC. J-J: 10 mm (0.39 in) min.
SEC. K-K: 10 mm (0.39 in) min., 10 mm (0.39 in) min.
SEC. L-L: 15 mm (0.59 in) min., 15 mm (0.59 in) min.
DETAIL A torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
DETAIL B torques: 1.6 to 2.1 kg-m (12 to 15 ft-lb), 1.8 to 2.1 kg-m (13 to 15 ft-lb), 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb), 0.38 to 0.51 kg-m (2.7 to 3.7 ft-lb)
DETAIL B reference distance: 162.6 mm (6.40 in)
DETAIL C torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
Pre-muffler to center tube connection torque: 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
DETAIL D torque: 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
DETAIL D reference distance: 140 mm (5.51 in)
DETAIL E torques: 0.93 to 1.2 kg-m (6.7 to 8.7 ft-lb), 1.1 to 1.2 kg-m (8 to 9 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note difference in clearance specs compared to California models (e.g. 40 mm propeller shaft clearance, 15 mm spare tire housing and shock absorber clearance). Always replace gaskets and fasteners marked '*'.
